numericLiterals.note: Finite paired numeric-token observations: 42 spellings, 18 accepted exact values and five retained lexical-versus-expression-stage differences. The kernel pins the model observations; the original external solc fixture checker and differential.py validate the pair. This is not universal lexer, constant-expression or compiler parity.
